_comment: Copy to collection-config.json and fill in your own values. The real file is gitignored because it describes a personal collection. Every key is optional; missing keys behave as empty.

collections._doc: Named groups of ComicVine volume IDs that are owned as collected editions rather than tracked issue by issue. comics-status.py excludes these from its drift report.

drift_ok._doc: ComicVine volume ID -> why it is watchlisted but absent from the reading plan. Keeps the drift report quiet about deliberate choices.
drift_ok.100004: cut from the reading order on YYYY-MM-DD; files and watchlist row kept

untracked_ok: _doc: library folder names the tracker deliberately does not follow, usually collected editions or one-shots with no ComicVine volume. Anything not tracked and not listed here is reported as a stray.
